Select molecule chembl_id (aliased as chembl_id), canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units from molecule_dictionary joined to activities on molregno, joined to assays on assay_id, joined to target_dictionary on tid, joined to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1862' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Sort by standard_value ascending. Limit to 500 rows. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row.
